title: Pronouns
parentNote: Pronouns replace nouns so we don't repeat names again and again. Practice by pointing at family members: "He is Papa, She is Didi, They are grandparents." Make it fun!
learnBullets: What a **pronoun** is — a word that takes the place of a noun
**Personal pronouns**: I, you, he, she, it, we, they
**Object pronouns**: me, you, him, her, it, us, them
Choosing the right pronoun for a sentence
learnItFirst:
**What is a Pronoun?**
A pronoun is a word that **takes the place of a noun** so we don't have to repeat the same name again and again.

```
❌ Riya likes Riya's bag. Riya takes Riya's bag to school.
✔️ Riya likes her bag. She takes it to school.
```

**Personal Pronouns Chart:**

| Person | Subject (does the action) | Object (receives the action) |
|--------|---------------------------|------------------------------|
| Talking about myself | I | me |
| Talking to someone | you | you |
| Talking about a boy/man | he | him |
| Talking about a girl/woman | she | her |
| Talking about a thing/animal | it | it |
| Talking about ourselves (group) | we | us |
| Talking about others (group) | they | them |

**Examples:**
- **I** am happy. (I = myself)
- **He** is my brother. (He = a boy)
- **She** likes to dance. (She = a girl)
- **It** is raining. (It = the weather/thing)
- **We** are playing. (We = my group)
- **They** are coming. (They = other people)

### 🧠 How to Choose the Right Pronoun
1. **Who/What** is the sentence talking about?
2. **Is it** one person or many people?
3. **Is the person** doing the action or receiving the action?

questions.content: Which word is a pronoun?
questions.why: She is a pronoun that replaces a girl's name

questions.content: "Amit is my friend. ___ is very kind." Choose the correct pronoun:
questions.why: Amit is a boy, so we use "he"

questions.content: "The book is on the table. ___ is red." Choose the correct pronoun:
questions.why: Book is a thing, so we use "it"

questions.content: "Priya and Neha are sisters. ___ love each other." Choose the correct pronoun:
questions.why: Priya and Neha are two people, so we use "they"

questions.content: Which pronoun is used for a girl?
questions.why: "She" is used for a girl or woman

questions.content: "I have a dog. ___ is brown." Which pronoun fits?
questions.why: Dog (when gender is not specified) uses "it"

questions.content: "___ am going to school." Which pronoun fits?
questions.why: "I" is used when talking about myself

questions.content: "My mother is cooking. ___ makes tasty food." Choose the pronoun:
questions.why: Mother is a woman, so we use "she"

questions.content: "Rohan and I are friends. ___ play together." Choose the pronoun:
questions.why: "Rohan and I" = we (my group)

questions.content: "___ are my grandparents." (talking about two people)
questions.why: Two people (grandparents) = they

questions.content: Replace the underlined word with a pronoun: "**Sita** is reading a book."
questions.why: Sita is a girl, so we use "she"

questions.content: Replace the underlined words with a pronoun: "**The children** are playing."
questions.why: Children (many people) = they

questions.content: "Please give the ball to ___." (me/I)
questions.why: After "to," we use object pronoun "me"

questions.content: "Rahul saw ___ at the park." (she/her)
questions.why: After "saw," we use object pronoun "her"

questions.content: Which sentence uses the pronoun correctly?
questions.why: "I" is the subject pronoun (doing the action)

questions.content: "The birds are flying. ___ are going south."
questions.why: Birds (many) = they

questions.content: "Mother said to Anita and me, '___ can go to the park.'"
questions.why: Mother is talking TO Anita and me, so she says "you"

questions.content: Replace the underlined words: "Give the toys to **Ravi and Riya**."
questions.why: Ravi and Riya (two people receiving) = them

questions.content: "This gift is for ___." (he/him)
questions.why: After "for," we use object pronoun "him"

questions.content: "___ is a beautiful day." (talking about the weather)
questions.why: Weather/day uses "it"

questions.content: "My friends and I went to the zoo. ___ saw many animals."
questions.why: "My friends and I" = we (I'm part of the group)

questions.content: Choose the WRONG sentence:
questions.why: Should be "He is my brother" (subject pronoun)

questions.content: "The teacher asked ___" to sit down. (we/us)
questions.why: After "asked," we use object pronoun "us"

questions.content: Fill in both blanks: "Mira lost ___ pencil. ___ was sad."
questions.why: Mira is a girl — her pencil, She was sad

questions.content: Which group has all pronouns?
questions.why: All three are pronouns

questions.content:
Read the passage and count the pronouns:
"Ravi has a cat. He loves it very much. It sleeps on his bed. They play together every day."
How many pronouns are there?
questions.why: He, it, It, his, They = 5 pronouns (his is possessive pronoun)

questions.content: Which sentence has MORE THAN ONE pronoun?

options.A: The book is on the table.

questions.why: She, it, me — 3 pronouns! Others have 0 pronouns

questions.content: Choose the correct pronouns: "Amit and ___ went to the market. ___ bought some fruits."
questions.why: "Amit and I" (subject), then "We bought" (subject)

questions.content: "_____ should always tell the truth." (one word that means "every person")
questions.why: "We should tell the truth" — includes everyone

questions.content: Find the sentence where the pronoun is used INCORRECTLY:

options.A: She and I are best friends.
options.D: Me and she are best friends.

questions.why: Should be "She and I are best friends"
